1445-4871-6277-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6277-6798.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

586-728-5258-5618-7183.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

5231-7388--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Repeat

1558-3861-3875-4231-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3861-3875-4231-7810.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1

4067-6254-7132.easyPrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
Your deck size is 8 or greater.
4067-6254-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing you to draw eight cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 until you have at least {5}{U} in your mana pool.
Repeat from step 1.

4871-5626-6441.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
The total mana value of the creature on the battlefield and the creature card in your graveyard is at most 6.
4871-5626-6441.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing a nontoken creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.
4871-5626-6441.notes: If the combined mana value of the creatures is less than 6, this combo will net infinite energy counters.

24-6899-7167.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Wrathful Raptors instead of you due to With Great Power... if you chose the largest number.
Wrathful Raptors triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-6899-7167.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

5231-6662-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2341-2495-4563.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Everflowing Chalice and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Everflowing Chalice and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Everflowing Chalice and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Nyx Lotus, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.

Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4195-4311-4574-4708.description:
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Dark Sphere from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.

Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Soldier and Insect by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.

Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Pemmin's Aura to become an artifact.
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Steelswarm Operator.
Repeat from step 2.
486-3525-6784.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Steelswarm Operator's first ability instead.

1287-5334-6318.description:
Cast Aethertide Whale by paying eight {E} if able or {4}{U}{U} otherwise.
When Aethertide Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Activate Aethertide Whale by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2532-2534-4617-4906.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-2534-4617-4906.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin abilities, adding eight {R} and giving creatures you control trample until end of turn.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Jaxis' ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Jaxis abilities, creating a token that's a copy of each other creature you control with haste.
Put the token Agrus Kos into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Agrus Kos and Coercive Recruiter tokens trigger.
Resolve the Agrus Kos trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat, using the Soulbright Flamekin token instead.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mortus Strider, adding {C}{C}.
Mortus Strider dies, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Mortus Strider by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2644-3652-4763-5147.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Ornithopter enters the battlefield, triggering Sai of the Shinobi, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to Ornithopter.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Ornithopter dies, triggering Koll, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
